spec.goal: Ensure GET /tasks/:id returns HTTP 404 with body {"error":"task_not_found"} when the requested task does not exist, without changing unrelated behavior.

When the task exists, preserve the current successful GET behavior and response.
Preserve all unrelated task routes and behavior.
constraints: Use the existing HttpResponse shape and TaskService lookup behavior.
Keep the existing route matching semantics for /tasks/:id.
Do not alter completion, reopening, listing, creation, or fallback not-found behavior.
nonGoals: Changing the behavior or error body for other routes.
Changing task storage, ID generation, or task serialization.
acceptance: GET /tasks/missing (or any nonexistent task ID) returns status 404.
The response body for a nonexistent task is exactly { error: "task_not_found" }.
GET /tasks/:id for an existing task continues to return status 200 and that task.
Existing tests remain unchanged and pass.
verification: Inspect or exercise the existing GET /tasks/:id missing-ID case and assert status 404 plus deep equality with { error: "task_not_found" }.
Exercise GET /tasks/:id for a created task and assert status 200.
Run the repository test script without modifying tests.
